entities.summary: Dmitry Alexandrovich Borovikov, also known by the nicknames "Kislyi" ("Sour") and "Kolovrat", was a Russian neo-Nazi and neopagan, the organizer of the extremist groups "Mad Crowd" and "Combat Terrorist Organization". In his position, he organized and perpetrated several racially motivated murders, including the murder of 8-year-old girl Khursheda Sultonova in 2004. Borovikov was fatally shot while being apprehended by operatives of the 18th department of the UBOP on 18 May 2006.
